overview: Plan a provider-aware CLI planning improvement with isolated docs, implementation, CLI wiring, and validation tasks.
assumptions: The active provider pool is limited to OpenAI and Gemini.
Anthropic remains in the registry but is excluded from routing while quota is unavailable.
decisions: Use Gemini for read-heavy planning context and OpenAI/Codex for implementation-oriented work.
Keep all handoffs manual in MVP 1.0; do not plan worker execution.
risks: The planner prompt can drift unless fixtures cover the expected JSON shape.
Generated task files must remain lintable after force-regeneration.
integration_notes: Run typecheck, tests, and build before accepting the plan implementation.

tasks.title: Document planner LLM contract
tasks.objective: Update command and roadmap docs to describe the planner LLM contract and fallback behavior.
tasks.execution_prompt: Update the relevant docs to describe the schema-validated planner LLM mode, deterministic fallback, and active provider pool behavior.
acceptance_contract: Docs mention schema validation before writing artifacts.
Docs mention deterministic fallback and provider exclusion rules.

tasks.title: Harden planner schema validation
tasks.objective: Tighten the planner draft schema and reject unavailable suggested models.
context_rules: Keep deterministic planning as a fallback.
Do not broaden provider access beyond available_providers.
tasks.execution_prompt: Update planner draft validation so fit values are enumerated and suggested_model must be active when provided. Add focused tests for accepted and rejected drafts.
acceptance_contract: Invalid fit values fail schema parsing.
Unavailable suggested models fail before artifacts are written.
Existing deterministic planner tests continue to pass.

tasks.title: Verify golden planner fixtures
tasks.objective: Use golden fixture files to verify planner draft parsing and generated handoff linting.
context_rules: Generated handoffs from fixtures must pass blueprint lint.
tasks.execution_prompt: Add or update tests that load planner draft fixtures from disk, parse them through the production schema, generate .blueprint artifacts, and run blueprint lint.
acceptance_contract: Golden valid fixture parses and generates lintable artifacts.
Invalid fixture fails with a specific error.
Tests do not require live provider calls.
